name: @openagt/skill-logs
description: The agent logs for coding agents: the record of every run made on a project, its card and its diary, kept on a branch of the project's repository and read with the logs command.

scripts.build: cp ../../skills/logs/SKILL.md SKILL.md && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build -c dashboard/vite.config.ts
scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}" && cp ../../skills/logs/SKILL.md SKILL.md
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=60000 'dist-test/**/*.test.js' && cd dashboard && vitest run
